measurement_description: The paper did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measured the linear decodability of 'refused knowledge' (e.g., controversial social or personal attributes like average IQ, net worth, substance abuse rates) for various entity types (Countries, Occupations, Political Figures, Synthetic Names).
